title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Company Description Console Flare is a premier online learning platform that helps both IT and non-IT professionals transition into data science and analytics careers. The organization emphasizes practical learning through hands-on, industry-relevant projects and provides ongoing career support, including resume building, interview preparation, and access to a strong alumni network. As a Microsoft Learning Partner, Console Flare offers globally recognized certification programs that focus on data analytics, machine learning, cloud computing, and related fields. Learners benefit from live interactive classes in Hindi, 1:1 doubt-clearing sessions, and lifetime access to recorded content. With over 5,000 learners supported, Console Flare is committed to helping individuals from diverse backgrounds bridge skill gaps and succeed in the data-driven job market. Role Description The Sales Counselor is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida, responsible for guiding prospective learners through Console Flares programs and enrollment process. Day-to-day tasks include engaging with inbound leads, making outbound calls, conducting counseling sessions, and clearly explaining course offerings, career outcomes, and placement support. The role involves understanding each learner’s background and goals, recommending suitable programs, and ensuring a smooth admission experience. The Sales Counselor will maintain accurate records in CRM tools, follow up on leads, and collaborate with marketing and operations teams to improve conversion and learner satisfaction. This position requires a strong focus on ethical sales practices, clear communication, and a commitment to helping learners make informed decisions about their careers. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain long-term learner relationships. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and active listening abilities. Candidates should possess proven Sales skills, including lead handling, consultative selling, and closing enrollments ethically. Candidates should possess solid Organization Skills, such as managing multiple leads, maintaining accurate documentation, and following structured workflows. Relevant experience in counseling, inside sales, or education/edtech sales is preferred. Comfort with using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and basic online communication platforms is beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Noida, meet performance targets, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a background in business, marketing, or education is an advantage.

Key Skills: Online Courses,Education Counseling,Career Counselling,Sales,Business Development,Admission Counselling,Presales,Counselling

Job Description Centre Business Development Manager Location: Gurgaon, India
 Function: Business Development / Commercial
 Reporting To: National Head Growth & Strategic Partnerships Role Overview The Centre Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving new business, institutional partnerships and profitable revenue growth for the ND Gurgaon medical screening centre. The role requires a highly commercial and execution-oriented individual who can identify opportunities, build relationships, develop propositions and convert them into recurring business. The person will develop business across areas including: Migration and visa-related medical and health services Overseas employer and recruitment-agency medicals University and student health requirements Corporate pre-employment and occupational-health services Insurance-related medical services Vaccination and travel-health services Other relevant institutional medical-screening opportunities The role will carry defined revenue and profitability targets, with performance-linked payouts. Strong performers will have the opportunity to progress into larger regional and national business development roles as the business expands. Key Responsibilities 1. Revenue & Business Development Own new-business development for ND Kochi and deliver agreed revenue and profitability targets. Build and convert a strong pipeline of institutional customers, referral partners and recurring business channels. Prioritise opportunities based on revenue potential, profitability, speed of conversion and repeat-business potential. 2. Institutional & Partnership Development Build relationships with corporates, employers, recruitment and manpower agencies, education and migration intermediaries, universities, insurers and other relevant organisations. Develop and convert opportunities across migration medicals, employer medicals, student health, occupational health, insurance medicals, vaccination and travel-health services. Build referral and channel partnerships capable of generating regular business. 3. Sales Conversion & Account Growth Drive opportunities from prospecting and customer meetings through proposal, negotiation, onboarding and revenue generation. Manage acquired accounts to ensure agreed business translates into recurring case volumes. Identify opportunities to increase volumes, introduce additional services and deepen key relationships. 4. Commercial Management & Coordination Maintain accurate CRM, pipeline, revenue and profitability tracking and provide regular updates to management. Work closely with Operations, Clinical, Finance, Marketing and other teams to develop and deliver customer-specific solutions. Support larger institutional opportunities and escalate regional, national or international opportunities where appropriate. Performance and Incentive Structure The role will carry revenue- and profitability-linked performance payouts, with meaningful upside for strong commercial performance. Consistently strong performers will be considered for larger regional and national commercial responsibilities. Mandatory Requirements Relevant experience in business development, B2B sales, institutional sales, partnerships or account acquisition. Demonstrated ability to independently identify prospects, build relationships and convert opportunities into revenue. Strong commercial orientation and comfort working against revenue and profitability targets. Experience managing the sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation, onboarding and account development. Strong relationship-building, negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of commercial opportunities. Working knowledge of CRM, pipeline management and sales reporting. Willingness to travel extensively within the relevant market. No specific educational qualification is required. Demonstrated commercial capability, relevant relationships and ability to generate business will be given greater weight than academic credentials. Preferred Experience Preference will be given to candidates who: Have recently generated meaningful business in one or more of the target segments relevant to this role. Can demonstrate a credible ability to generate revenue within a short period of joining. Bring active relationships with corporates, employers, recruitment/manpower agencies, education consultants, universities, insurers or other relevant institutional customers. Have experience in healthcare, diagnostics, medical screening, occupational health, migration or related sectors. Have personally acquired and grown institutional accounts rather than primarily servicing existing accounts. Possess a strong commercial network in Delhi NCR. Can communicate effectively in Hindi and English.

title: Export Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 The Export Business Development Executive, also known as the Export Executive, is responsible for driving business growth through the development and management of export opportunities. They play a crucial role in identifying new markets, establishing relationships with international customers, and ensuring smooth export operations. The Export Executive collaborates with internal teams and external partners to achieve sales targets, expand the companys global presence, and ensure customer satisfaction. 

 Job Details 
 Location: Ahemedabad Work Time: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm Number of Position Open: 02 Position Open Currently Position Open currently 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Market Research and Analysis: Conduct comprehensive market research to identify potential export markets, assess market trends, competitors, and customer preferences. Analyze market intelligence to develop effective export strategies and identify new business opportunities. Business Development: Generate leads and develop new business opportunities in target markets. Actively prospect and engage with potential international customers through various channels, including trade shows, online platforms, and referrals. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects. Customer Relationship Management: Establish and nurture relationships with international customers, agents, distributors, and other stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts, addressing their needs, resolving issues, and ensuring high customer satisfaction. Sales and Negotiations: Drive sales growth by presenting product offerings, negotiating contracts, and closing deals. Develop and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals to prospective customers. Collaborate with the sales team to meet or exceed sales targets. Export Operations Management: Coordinate and oversee export operations, including order processing, documentation, logistics, and shipment tracking. Ensure compliance with export regulations, trade policies, and legal requirements of target markets. Collaborate with internal teams to fulfil orders and resolve any operational issues. Export Documentation: Prepare and manage export documentation, including invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping documents. Ensure accuracy and compliance with export regulations and customer requirements Export Compliance: Stay updated on export control regulations, trade sanctions, and international trade laws. Ensure compliance with applicable export regulations and implement export compliance programs within the company. Market Intelligence and Reporting: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences. Provide regular reports and insights to management regarding export sales performance, market dynamics, and opportunities for business growth Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams, including production, logistics, finance, and customer service, to ensure seamless export operations and customer satisfaction. Coordinate with these teams to fulfil orders, address customer inquiries, and resolve issues effectively. Continuous Learning and Industry Knowledge: Stay updated on industry trends, emerging markets, and technological advancements that may impact export operations. Continuously enhance knowledge and skills through self-learning, training, and participation in industry events. Production Plant Visit: Coordinate and facilitate visits to the production plants in Morbi, if necessary, during customer visits. Provide guided tours, explain the manufacturing processes, and address any customer inquiries or concerns related to production New Customer Approach: Proactively identify and approach potential new customers in target markets. Conduct market research to identify potential leads and develop strategies to attract and acquire new customers. Initiate contact, introduce the companys products and services, and establish relationships with new customers. Product Selection Assistance: Accompany clients during product selection to provide expert advice, insights, and recommendations. Assist clients in understanding the product offerings, specifications, and customization options available to meet their specific requirements. Sales Generation: Actively pursue sales opportunities with existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and offering new product solutions. Identify customer needs and propose suitable products or services to drive sales growth. Sales Follow-up: Follow up on sales leads, inquiries, and quotations to convert them into confirmed orders. Provide timely and accurate information to customers, address any concerns or objections, and negotiate terms to secure sales. 

 Skills to be successful 
 Master s / Bachelors degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related field Proven experience in export business development, international sales, or export operations, preferably in the relevant industry. Strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to drive sales growth and manage export operations. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills Solid understanding of export regulations, trade compliance, and international business practices Analytical mindset with the ability to gather and interpret market data and make informed business decisions. Proficiency in using CRM software, export management systems, and Microsoft Office Suite. Fluency in English (additional language skills are a plus). Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

title: Team Lead Sales Compensation
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a Team Lead, Sales Compensation to oversee the day-to-day administration, governance, and analysis of our global commission structures. In this role, you will act as a player-coach-managing a team of compensation analysts while directly handling plan modeling and high-level stakeholder escalations. You will ensure accurate, timely incentive payouts while aligning with the broader corporate strategy. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage a portfolio of compensation-related accounts as primary advisor Build strong relationships with stakeholders through proactive communication and insights Identify opportunities to optimize compensation structures and performance programs Develop strategies aligned with sales needs, industry benchmarks, and organizational goals Monitor compensation data, performance trends, and compliance to support accuracy and retention Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve compensation issues and support initiatives Present compensation proposals and performance reviews to demonstrate value and alignment Resolve escalations by coordinating timely and accurate payouts Forecast compensation trends, payout risks, and financial impacts using reporting tools Support plan renewals through strong analysis and stakeholder engagement 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Team Leadership Operations 
 Supervise a team of Sales Compensation Analysts, managing workflows to meet monthly payroll deadlines. Conduct quality audits and act as internal Auditor on commission calculations, quota assignments, and manual adjustments / Exceptions. Act as primary escalation point for complex compensation disputes and policy exceptions. 
 
 Strategy Compensation Design 
 Partner with leadership (Finance, Sales Ops, HR) to calibrate Commission and incentive structures. Model commission and bonus scenarios periodically to provide management with clear analytical insights. Draft documentation outlining clear, compliant plan rules for the global sales force. 
 
 Analytics System Governance 
 Maintain system integrity within SPM/ICM software (CaptivateIQ). Deliver executive reporting on quota attainment trends, cost of credit, and overall plan ROI. Enforce internal controls and SOX compliance standards across all payment systems. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education : Bachelor s degree in finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field. Experience : 13+ years in sales compensation, corporate finance, or sales operations, with at least 1-2 years in a senior or supervisory capacity. Technical Skills : Advanced proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and hands-on experience with modern SPM platforms. Analytical Mindset : Proven ability to transform massive datasets into executive-ready strategic insights. Communication : Strong interpersonal skills to navigate sensitive compensation talks with sales executives.

title: Regional Head Business Development
description:
REGIONAL BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT 
 ABOUT UNITILE: 
 Celebrating 32 years of excellence, Unitile shines as a beacon of innovation and trust in the building 
 materials industry. Our dedication to intelligent, sustainable, and flexible solutions has earned us recognition as India's number one raised access floor brand and Asia's Prestigious Rising Brand (2021) by BARC. As a Great Place to Work Certified company, we prioritize a positive work culture fostering collaboration and growth, ensuring our employees feel valued and empowered. Our certification reflects our commitment to creating an environment where our employees rate their experience positively, highlighting our focus on trust, respect, and teamwork. 
 Our expertise in modular indoor and outdoor flooring systems, structural ceilings, partitions and acoustics solutions enhances any space's efficiency, adaptability, and aesthetics by seamlessly blending form and function. With a portfolio of over 15,000 successful workplace transformations globally, we are driven by a passionate team of dynamic leaders committed to shared success. Unitile is poised to continue leading the way in innovation and sustainability. By focusing on user-centric design, we are creating solutions that not only meet but exceed the demands of tomorrow's spaces. We remain committed to pushing boundaries, driving progress, and shaping the future of the industry. JOB SUMMARY : The Regional Head Business Development will drive Unitile RAF market expansion by identifying new opportunities, geographies and market segments- influencing early-stage project decisions, and securing specifications in high-value corporate interior projects. The role focuses on engaging key stakeholders: 
Clients, PMCs, architects, and designers-to guide them toward adopting Unitile RAF solutions This is a strategic market development role, centered on stakeholder influence, account qualification and specification-led pipeline creation, not on direct sales execution or project coordination. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Market Development & Specification Influence 
Identify potential clients, segments, and industries with high potential for raised floor adoption. 
 Position Unitile RAF as the preferred solution across corporate interior projects. Drive brand and product specification into project documents, BOQs, and design submissions. 
Prepare and ensure inclusion of Unitile make-list in all relevant tenders, design packs, and procurement frameworks. 
Engage early in the project lifecycle to shape client awareness, solution fit, and decision direction. 
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and opportunity assessment for expansion. 
Generate long-term strategic opportunities in commercial real estate sector. 
 Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Building 
Build strong connect with corporate clients (CRE / workplace / admin leaders), PMC consultants, Architects & Design Studios (studio heads, design leads), Co-working players, workplace consultants, MEP consultants, and corporate real estate teams. Position the company and its raised floor solutions with specifiers to secure product specifications. 
Influence technical approvals, design recommendations, and procurement preferences in favor of Unitile. 
Represent the brand in industry forums, events, exhibitions, and trade networks. 
 Lead Generation & Opportunity Creation 
Develop a robust pipeline of potential, early stage and qualified projects for the sales team. 
Identify early-stage project opportunities and qualified leads with the regional sales team. 
Build partnerships with contractors, developers, and channel partners. 
Strategic Insights & Market Intelligence 
Monitor market trends, technology advancements, customer needs, and competitive landscape. 
Provide insights and recommendations to leadership for market entry, pricing, and positioning. 
Work with marketing teams to tailor campaigns for targeted new markets. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration 
Work closely with the sales, estimation, marketing, and product teams to ensure alignment on strategy. 
Work in partnership with the sales team to pursue and convert opportunities influenced through specifications and stakeholder engagement. 
Maintain active involvement through the sales cycle as a strategic partner, while commercial submissions, pricing, tendering, and execution remain with the sales and operations teams. 
 Brand Development & Institutional Positioning 
Strengthen Unitiles brand visibility and presence across newly targeted regions and strategic accounts. Build long-term institutional relationships with clients, PMCs, architects, designers, and influencers to establish sustained trust and preference for Unitile RAF solutions. 
Engage in pre-sales advocacy without getting involved in negotiation or order booking. Position Unitile as the preferred standard for quality, durability, and reliable RAF performance in workplace and commercial projects. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIE Demonstrated track record of building and scaling B2B pipelines from prospecting to conversion. 
Expertise in solution selling and ability to translate customer pain points into value propositions.

title: Content Lead — YouTube (Long-form Scriptwriting) – Bengaluru
description:
Content Lead YouTube (Long-form Scriptwriting) Bengaluru Who We Are? We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill. GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could. Then AI changed what " upskilling " even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not. So, we built Outskill , our AI education arm, to close that gap practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today Outskill is one of the largest AI education companies in the world: 20M+ learners across 160+ countries , and programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation. Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028. What that actually feels like day to day: we're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday. If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here. Why This Role Exists We grew Vaibhav Sisinty's YouTube channel from 60K to 840K+ subscribers in about a year , and we're now publishing across multiple channels and formats from AI news and tool walkthroughs to model comparisons and long-form documentaries. As we scale, we need a strong content leader who can own the long-form script function end-to-end while building a team that can consistently deliver high-quality scripts without depending on one person. In this role, you'll own hooks, structure, pacing, research accuracy, voice consistency and viewer retention , while building the systems and team required to scale our content output. What You'll Do Content & Script Ownership Own the long-form script function across Vaibhav's channel and Outskill. Write and review long-form YouTube scripts from hook to close. Own hooks, structure, pacing and voice consistency. Ensure every script is engaging, accurate and built to hold viewer attention. Work closely with the creator and content team to translate topics into compelling narratives. Personally write scripts and set the quality bar for the team. Audience Retention & Performance Own script performance through viewer retention and engagement. Track Average View Duration (AVD) and key retention points. Analyse retention graphs to identify where and why viewers drop off. Improve hooks, transitions, structure and pacing based on performance data. Run structural experiments across different formats and content styles. Use insights from published videos to continuously improve future scripts. Research & Content Accuracy Build a strong research and fact-checking process for AI, technology and business content. Ensure every factual claim is properly researched and verified. Build research protocols and fact-checking standards. Work with researchers to ensure scripts are accurate, credible and up to date. Simplify complex AI and technology concepts without losing accuracy. Build a system where factual accuracy doesn't depend on one person. Team Leadership Lead and develop a team of 510 writers and researchers . Hire, onboard and develop writers and researchers. Set clear writing standards and quality benchmarks. Conduct regular script reviews and provide actionable feedback. Help new writers reach publishable quality quickly. Manage performance and address underperformance directly and fairly. Build a high-ownership, high-quality writing culture. Content Systems & Processes Build scalable systems that allow the team to consistently produce high-quality content. Create script briefs, templates and review processes. Build hook libraries and reusable writing frameworks. Establish draft stages, review gates and turnaround timelines. Develop AI-assisted research and drafting workflows. Build systems that allow quality to scale without requiring constant rewriting by the Content Lead. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the broader YouTube content team. Collaborate with the YouTube Content Strategist/Packaging Lead on topics and content direction. Work with editors to ensure the script translates effectively into the final video. Collaborate directly with Vaibhav and other creators. Partner with researchers, designers and content teams to improve overall video performance. Challenge ideas constructively and make decisions based on evidence and audience data. What We're Looking For We're looking for a hands-on content leader and exceptional long-form writer who understands that great YouTube scripts are built around retention, storytelling and audience psychology not just good writing. The ideal candidate combines strong writing craft, analytical thinking, research rigour, AI fluency and team leadership . Must-Have 5+ years of experience writing long-form video content for YouTube or a comparable platform. Proven portfolio of long-form scripts/videos with measurable performance. Strong understanding of YouTube retention, Average View Duration (AVD) and audience behaviour . 2+ years of experience managing 510 writers, researchers or content professionals . Experience hiring, onboarding, reviewing and managing content teams. Proven ability to write strong hooks, structures and narratives that hold viewer attention. Strong research and fact-checking skills with a high bar for accuracy. Experience working directly with a YouTuber/creator on channel growth. Comfortable reading and interpreting YouTube analytics and retention graphs. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Genuine interest in AI and emerging technology , with the ability to understand and explain complex topics clearly. Strong ownership and ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Good-to-Have Experience working on a YouTube channel with 1M+ subscribers . Experience managing scripts across multiple YouTube channels . Background in tech journalism, science communication, documentary production or business content . Experience creating AI, technology or business content for a global audience. Experience building AI-assisted research, writing or content workflows . Experience personally creating or publishing content. Experience building scalable content systems and writing frameworks. What We Offer Opportunity to own the YouTube long-form content function at one of India's fastest-growing AI education companies. Direct access to work closely with Vaibhav Sisinty and the founder's office team . Opportunity to build and lead a 510 member writing and research team . High ownership and direct impact on channel growth and content performance. Access to India's best AI minds, premium AI courses and cutting-edge AI tools and workflows. Free access to GrowthSchool and Outskill programs, including the AI Mastermind and fellowships. Opportunity to work alongside the founding team at GrowthSchool HQ. Fast career growth in a high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment. Competitive compensation based on experience and assignment performance. Work Location Bengaluru On-site, 6 days a week.

description:

Contact: Siyona (9175448085)

Role summary You will handle the day-to-day financial operations at Provakil processing invoices, tracking payments, managing vendor accounts, and ensuring every transaction is recorded accurately and on time. This is the operational backbone of the finance function The role spans accounts receivable (invoicing, payment follow-ups, client coordination). Youll work closely with the Finance Manager and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep financial operations running smoothly. Accuracy is non-negotiable in this role - every invoice, every entry, every reconciliation needs to be correct the first time. 
 What youll do Accounts receivable Raise tax invoices and proforma invoices for enterprise clients and share them within defined timelines no delays in billing Follow up with clients for payment collection: track outstanding amounts, make follow-up calls, and update payment status on internal systems Book payments received from clients accurately in the accounting system match payments to invoices, flag discrepancies, and reconcile regularly Upload tax invoices on client vendor portals as required many enterprise clients have specific portal-based submission processes Prepare and share balance confirmation statements as per client requests Follow up with clients on TDS receivables track TDS deductions, collect TDS certificates, and ensure they are accounted for correctly 
 Accounts payable Prepare and maintain the expense register track all company expenses with accurate categorisation and documentation Issue Form 16A (TDS certificates) to vendors within prescribed timelines Manage petty cash: process petty cash vouchers, maintain the petty cash register, and ensure regular reconciliation 
 Financial record-keeping & compliance support Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all financial transactions in the accounting system every entry should be audit-ready Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for internal and external audits when required Maintain organised digital and physical records of invoices, receipts, contracts, and compliance documents 
 Internal coordination Coordinate with the Sales and Account Management teams on client invoicing: billing schedules, special terms, credit notes, and invoice corrections Respond to internal queries on invoice status, payment timelines, and vendor account details in a timely and accurate manner 
 Must-have skills 02 years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or a similar role internships in accounting firms or finance departments count Working knowledge of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes: invoicing, payment tracking, vendor management, and reconciliation Basic understanding of Indian taxation: GST (input and output), TDS/TCS, and how they apply to invoices and vendor payments Hands-on proficiency with accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, or equivalent) and MS Excel for data entry, tracking, and basic reporting Accuracy and attention to detail that is non-negotiable financial data has zero tolerance for errors, and your work must reflect that standard Good communication skills — you’ll be calling clients for payment follow-ups and coordinating with vendors, so you need to be clear, professional, and persistent Organised approach to work — you manage multiple invoices, deadlines, and records simultaneously without letting anything slip 
 Good-to-have skills • B.Com, M.Com, or equivalent qualification in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance • Experience working with enterprise client billing processes, vendor portals, and procurement teams • Familiarity with bank reconciliation processes and month-end closing activities • Exposure to statutory compliance workflows: GST return filing, TDS return filing, or audit preparation • Experience in a SaaS or technology company where subscription-based billing is the revenue model 
 What you’ll learn in this role • End-to-end financial operations at a growing technology company — AR, AP, compliance, and reporting in one role, giving you a broad foundation in corporate finance • How enterprise billing and collections work in a B2B SaaS business — subscription models, procurement processes, and the financial mechanics that drive recurring revenue • Working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance (GST, TDS, audits) through hands-on execution, not just theory

title: Quickbook Accountant
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically proficient QuickBooks Accountant to manage accounting and bookkeeping activities for US-based clients. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with QuickBooks, a strong understanding of accounting principles, and the ability to maintain accurate financial records while meeting strict deadlines. This role requires ownership, analytical thinking, process discipline, and effective communication during US business hours. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for US-based clients using QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Record, classify, and review income, expenses, accounts payable, and accounts receivable transactions. Perform accurate bank, credit card, and general ledger reconciliations. Review financial data for discrepancies, incorrect entries, duplicate transactions, and unusual balances. Prepare and analyze financial statements, including Profit Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports. Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records and support timely payment and collection tracking. Assist with client invoicing, expense reimbursements, payroll-related journal entries, and other accounting processes. Manage chart of accounts, journal entries, adjustments, and month-end closing activities as required. Maintain organized, complete, and audit-ready financial documentation. Coordinate with clients, CPAs, tax professionals, and internal accounting teams whenever required. Prepare periodic accounting reports and communicate financial discrepancies or pending requirements proactively. Ensure all accounting activities are completed accurately and within defined timelines. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Performance Expectations 
 High accuracy in transaction recording, classification, and reconciliation. Timely completion of weekly and monthly accounting activities. Reliable maintenance of clean, organized, and audit-ready books. Proactive identification and resolution of accounting discrepancies. Consistent adherence to accounting processes, client instructions, and reporting deadlines. Clear documentation and professional communication with clients and accounting stakeholders. Strong ownership of financial data integrity and accounting deliverables. 
 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 1-3 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably with US-based clients. Strong practical experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop. Sound knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and financial statements. Practical understanding of US bookkeeping practices and accounting workflows. Proficiency in bank reconciliation, credit card reconciliation, journal entries, and general ledger maintenance. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Excellent attention to detail, analytical ability, and problem-solving skills. Good written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounting tasks within deadlines. Stable internet connection and personal laptop. Willingness to work US night shifts and commit to the role long-term. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting US small businesses, accounting firms, or international clients. Familiarity with accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll entries, and month-end closing. Exposure to Zoho Books, Xero, Sage, or other accounting platforms. Experience using Slack, Trello, Asana, or similar collaboration and project-management tools. Basic understanding of US sales tax, 1099-related bookkeeping support, or CPA coordination. 
 
 Who Should Apply 
 Accounting professionals with practical QuickBooks experience. Candidates who are confident handling financial records, reconciliations, and reporting. Individuals who value accuracy, confidentiality, process discipline, and accountability. Professionals seeking a structured, long-term opportunity supporting international clients.

description:
EY GDS - Risk Consulting Internal Audit - Manager 
 Job locations - Hyderabad/Chennai 
 Role Summary 
 We are seeking an accomplished Manager for the EY GDS Risk Consulting Internal Audit team. The role involves leading internal audits, internal controls assessments, business process reviews, and sector-focused risk consulting engagements for global clients. You will collaborate with EY member firms worldwide, leveraging advanced technologies and industry-leading practices to deliver high-quality outcomes. 
 The opportunity This is a client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice. You will work closely with senior stakeholders on complex risk, process, and controls engagements while contributing to the development of innovative, technology-enabled solutions, leveraging propriety (emerging) tools and technologies - such as GenAI, Advanced Analytics and RPA. You’ll gain broad exposure across global clients, strengthening your domain expertise and leadership capabilities.

Oversee engagement teams, ensuring high-quality deliverables aligned with EY’s global standards, timelines, and budgets. Identify process gaps, assess risks, and design improvement recommendations based on industry’s best practices and client’s business environment. Apply a structured, solution focused approach to problem solving while executing engagements and preparing high quality audit reports, working papers and client communications. Continuously monitor engagement progress, manage risks, and ensure timely communication of status and expected outcomes to key stakeholders (client as well as internal). Proactively identify engagement related risks and escalate issues in a timely manner in accordance with firm protocols.

Contribute to business development initiatives including proposals, RFP responses, and thought leadership. Support automation and innovation initiatives leveraging GenAI, Advanced Analytics and RPA to enhance service delivery. Stay updated on global trends, regulatory reforms, and emerging risks; translate insights into actionable recommendations. Collaborating with colleagues across multiple service lines, sharing your knowledge and experience to foster business growth and guide business decisions. 
 Operational Excellence 
 Drive engagement productivity improvements and operational efficiencies. Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement terms as well as EY’s global quality & risk management procedures. 
 Skills and Attributes for Success

Prior experience delivering risk consulting solutions (internal audits, internal controls, business process reviews) for global clients. Excellent communication, presentation, and reportwriting skills. Proficiency with GenAI tools, MS Office, data analytics, and data validation. Ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively. Strong stakeholder management skills. Big Four or top-tier consulting experience preferred. 
 To Qualify for This Role, You Must Have 
 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Internal Audit, Risk Advisory, Process & Controls roles within a consulting firm or large corporate environment. Handson experience in leading internal audit engagements endtoend, including planning, execution, reporting, and closure across multiple processes and functions. Strong expertise in internal controls, business process reviews, and risk assessments, including design and operating effectiveness testing. Working knowledge of data analytics and technologyenabled audit techniques, including the use of advanced Excel, analytics tools, and automation where applicable. Professional qualification preferred (CA, MBA, CPA, CIA, or equivalent), or progress toward one. Ability to lead upskilling programs and build solution assets in collaboration with EY Global SMRs / sector leaders. Experience growing/stabilizing GDS roles on global accounts and contributing to multi-region delivery models. 
 What We Look For

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.  Role Overview The Factory Accountant will be responsible for day-to-day accounting and financial control at the Kurla processing facility, covering GRN and stock inward accounting, production data recording, inventory management, vendor coordination, invoicing, and petty cash administration. The role requires close coordination with the Factory Head, Accounts Manager, Store/Production teams, and vendors to ensure accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial records. 
 Key Responsibilities Goods Receipt & Stock Inward Prepare and verify Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) for all material inward at the Kurla facility. Ensure stock inward quantities are reconciled against purchase orders, invoices, and physical receipt. Flag discrepancies in quantity, quality, or documentation to the Factory Head/Accounts Manager promptly. Production Data & System Entries Punch daily production detail accurately in the designated Google Sheet trackers. Enter and update production and stock data in SAP within defined timelines. Maintain consistency between Google Sheet records and SAP entries; reconcile any variances. MIS & Reporting Prepare regular MIS reports covering stock inward, production output, inventory levels, and vendor payments. Support month-end and periodic closing with accurate factory-level data. Share timely reports with the Factory Head/Accounts Manager and Head Office finance team as required. Invoicing & Vendor Coordination Process and verify vendor invoices for accuracy against GRNs, POs, and agreed rates before approval. Coordinate with vendors on invoice queries, documentation gaps, and payment follow-ups. Raise sales/internal invoices as applicable and ensure correctness of rates, quantities, and taxes. Inventory Management Maintain accurate inventory records for raw material, packaging, and finished goods at the factory. Support periodic physical stock counts/cycle counts and reconcile with system records. Report slow-moving, near-expiry, or discrepant stock to the Factory Head/Accounts Manager. Petty Cash & Other Accounts Tasks Handle day-to-day petty cash at the factory disbursement, voucher documentation, and reconciliation. Maintain proper supporting documents and approvals for all petty cash expenses. Assist with other factory-level accounting and administrative tasks as assigned. 
 Key Skills & Competencies Strong hands-on proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, formulas, data reconciliation) – Mandatory. Working knowledge of SAP (inventory/production/accounting modules) and Google Sheets. Good understanding of GRN, stock inward, and inventory accounting processes, preferably in a food/FMCG/seafood processing environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and invoice verification. Basic knowledge of GST-compliant invoicing and vendor reconciliation. Good communication skills for coordination with vendors, store, and production teams. Ability to manage petty cash responsibly with proper documentation discipline. Ability to work from the factory location and coordinate across shifts as needed. 
 Qualification & Experience B.Com / M.Com or equivalent degree in Commerce/Accounting. 2–5 years of relevant experience in factory/plant-level accounting, preferably in food processing, seafood, or FMCG manufacturing. Our teams take an active part in international infrastructure projects, specializing in aviation, bridges, highways, geotechnics, railways, tunnels, and foundations. Job Description We are looking for a Principal Aviation Engineer to spearhead our airfield team in Noida or Bangalore. As the founding member of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its growth and long-term success. In this position, you will lead the delivery of airfield civil engineering design and maintenance projects, guiding them through every stage, from feasibility and option studies to detailed design and construction. Your work will support a diverse portfolio of clients across the UK and internationally. Job Location : Noida/Bangalore Key Responsibilities: Lead and grow a local team in the preparation of designs for Airfields at International, Regional, and Domestic Airports and for Military Airfields. Prepare airfield pavement designs. Analyse geotechnical and soil investigation information and request necessary surveys and tests. Undertake geometric and grading design of Runways, Taxiways, Aprons, service roads, etc. Undertake storm water drainage and water management system design for airports. Undertake setting out design of Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL). Oversee the production of Civil 3D Design of civil works and infrastructure and 3D models for airfield projects. Help to coordinate design across multiple disciplines including pavement engineering, structural engineering, drainage, electrical and Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL) etc. Prepare specifications for civil and electrical works. Prepare feasible, logical and efficient work phasing proposals to carry out the construction works. Undertake civil works design and design reviews covering all stages of design. Support in the engagement and management of subconsultants. Support in the preparation of tender documentation and in the support of clients during procurement processes for Airfield Civil Works. Support in the preparation of methodologies, design proposals, resources estimation, etc. for preparation of bids. Candidate should be able to travel frequently to UK and Internationally for site visits and to visit MM UK Offices. Complete assigned tasks in accordance with quality, timescales, and budgeted hours. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives to develop design solutions that meet client requirements and regulatory standards. Comply with industry standards and safety regulations. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with Mott MacDonalds quality standard procedures. Provide leadership with knowledge management and digital delivery initiatives for the team. Lead, inspire and motivate people in the team to achieve high levels of performance and excellence. Provide supervision and mentoring, identifying opportunities for professional development and progression along with specific line management responsibilities for designated direct reports. Foster a culture of right first-time delivery and work with Project Managers/Principals to ensure effective project delivery. Recruit and manage Senior and Junior Team members. Undertake line management duties. Lead visits to Airfields around the world in the monitoring of construction works and in the production of reports on progress. Provide leadership and line management support to Senior and Airfield Engineers in their development of Airfield designs for airports in the UK and around the world. Interface with clients, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure project requirements and standards are met. Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Candidate Specification Candidate should have experience in Airfield Engineering Design and the Management of Airfield Design and should have good CAD (2D and 3D) capabilities. Candidate should have excellent written and spoken English and the ability to speak additional languages would be desirable. Candidate should from ideally be members of the Institution of Civil Engineers or similar internationally recognised professional body and have a Chartered Engineer or equivalent status. Experience in bid and client account management would be advantageous. Candidate may be required to travel to the UK and to selected locations internationally (subject to mutual agreement). Qualifications: Degree qualified in Civil engineering (BE/B. Tech./ME/M. Tech./ MSc or equivalent). M.Tech or Master s degree in Transportation, or a related field. Minimum 12 to 15 years of civil infrastructure design experience at airports. Essential Skills and Experience: Experience in and a commitment to effective management of Health, Safety and Welfare, Safety by Design. Knowledge and experience of using AutoCAD, Civil 3D and relevant other airfield engineering design software packages such as AviPlan, SkySafe and FAARFIELD is preferable but not essential. Experience of international airfield design standards such as BAA, ICAO and FAA. Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and new technologies. Experience of managing project teams and technical leadership would be advantageous. Commercial and financial awareness, and the ability to plan and monitor project programmes, budgets and resources to ensure delivery to time and cost constraints. General IT software skills, such as, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, ProjectWise, ACC, Bentley and Autodesk software. Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with all levels of staff and clients (written and verbal). Desirable Competencies / Skills: Experience in the preparation of fee proposals and tender submissions would be advantageous. Knowledge of the sustainable design of airfield and associated infrastructure would be advantageous. title: Export Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 The Export Business Development Executive, also known as the Export Executive, is responsible for driving business growth through the development and management of export opportunities. They play a crucial role in identifying new markets, establishing relationships with international customers, and ensuring smooth export operations. The Export Executive collaborates with internal teams and external partners to achieve sales targets, expand the companys global presence, and ensure customer satisfaction. 

 Job Details 
 Location: Ahemedabad Work Time: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm Number of Position Open: 02 Position Open Currently Position Open currently 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Market Research and Analysis: Conduct comprehensive market research to identify potential export markets, assess market trends, competitors, and customer preferences. Analyze market intelligence to develop effective export strategies and identify new business opportunities. Business Development: Generate leads and develop new business opportunities in target markets. Actively prospect and engage with potential international customers through various channels, including trade shows, online platforms, and referrals. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects. Customer Relationship Management: Establish and nurture relationships with international customers, agents, distributors, and other stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts, addressing their needs, resolving issues, and ensuring high customer satisfaction. Sales and Negotiations: Drive sales growth by presenting product offerings, negotiating contracts, and closing deals. Develop and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals to prospective customers. Collaborate with the sales team to meet or exceed sales targets. Export Operations Management: Coordinate and oversee export operations, including order processing, documentation, logistics, and shipment tracking. Ensure compliance with export regulations, trade policies, and legal requirements of target markets. Collaborate with internal teams to fulfil orders and resolve any operational issues. Export Documentation: Prepare and manage export documentation, including invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping documents. Ensure accuracy and compliance with export regulations and customer requirements Export Compliance: Stay updated on export control regulations, trade sanctions, and international trade laws. Ensure compliance with applicable export regulations and implement export compliance programs within the company. Market Intelligence and Reporting: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences. Provide regular reports and insights to management regarding export sales performance, market dynamics, and opportunities for business growth Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams, including production, logistics, finance, and customer service, to ensure seamless export operations and customer satisfaction. Coordinate with these teams to fulfil orders, address customer inquiries, and resolve issues effectively. Continuous Learning and Industry Knowledge: Stay updated on industry trends, emerging markets, and technological advancements that may impact export operations. Continuously enhance knowledge and skills through self-learning, training, and participation in industry events. Production Plant Visit: Coordinate and facilitate visits to the production plants in Morbi, if necessary, during customer visits. Provide guided tours, explain the manufacturing processes, and address any customer inquiries or concerns related to production New Customer Approach: Proactively identify and approach potential new customers in target markets. Conduct market research to identify potential leads and develop strategies to attract and acquire new customers. Initiate contact, introduce the companys products and services, and establish relationships with new customers. Product Selection Assistance: Accompany clients during product selection to provide expert advice, insights, and recommendations. Assist clients in understanding the product offerings, specifications, and customization options available to meet their specific requirements. Sales Generation: Actively pursue sales opportunities with existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and offering new product solutions. Identify customer needs and propose suitable products or services to drive sales growth. Sales Follow-up: Follow up on sales leads, inquiries, and quotations to convert them into confirmed orders. Provide timely and accurate information to customers, address any concerns or objections, and negotiate terms to secure sales. 

 Skills to be successful 
 Master s / Bachelors degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related field Proven experience in export business development, international sales, or export operations, preferably in the relevant industry. Strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to drive sales growth and manage export operations. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills Solid understanding of export regulations, trade compliance, and international business practices Analytical mindset with the ability to gather and interpret market data and make informed business decisions. Proficiency in using CRM software, export management systems, and Microsoft Office Suite. Fluency in English (additional language skills are a plus). Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

title: Post-Sales Operations Executive
description:
Job Description: Post-Sales Operations Executive Hiring | BoxUp Luxury Gifting Post-Sales Operations Executive Department: Post-Sales Operations / Customer Experience Experience: 23 Years Location: Bengaluru Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Post-Sales Operations Lead / Head of Operations About BoxUp BoxUp Luxury Gifting is a corporate gifting and personalised gifting company focused on creating meaningful experiences through thoughtful products, customised packaging, and seamless fulfilment. We work with leading corporates and businesses to deliver customised gifting solutions, managing everything from product selection and branding to packaging and delivery. As we continue to scale our operations, we are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Post-Sales Operations Executive to ensure a smooth and exceptional customer experience after every confirmed order. Role Overview The Post-Sales Operations Executive will be responsible for managing the complete order execution process once a sale has been confirmed by the sales team and a job card has been created. The individual will serve as the primary coordination point between customers and internal departments, ensuring that every order progresses seamlessly through mockup approvals, procurement, production, quality checks, dispatch, and final delivery. This role requires strong ownership, excellent communication, effective follow-up skills, and the ability to manage multiple orders simultaneously while ensuring customer satisfaction and timely execution. The objective is simple: Once the sales team closes an order, the Post-Sales Operations Executive takes ownership of its execution until successful delivery and customer feedback. Key Responsibilities 1. Job Card Review & Order Handover Review job cards received from the sales team after order confirmation. Understand customer requirements, product specifications, quantities, branding, packaging, delivery locations, and committed timelines. Identify missing information or discrepancies and coordinate with the sales team for clarification. Ensure all relevant documents, approvals, and customer commitments are properly recorded. Prepare an execution plan and initiate the order workflow. Take complete ownership of the order after the handover. 2. Internal Department Coordination Coordinate with the mockup and design team for artwork, branding layouts, and sample preparation. Follow up with the procurement team to ensure timely sourcing and availability of products and materials. Work closely with printing and production teams to ensure execution as per approved specifications. Coordinate with quality control to ensure products meet the required standards. Liaise with the warehouse team for packing, inventory readiness, and dispatch preparation. Ensure all departments are aligned on timelines and deliverables. Proactively follow up to prevent delays and resolve operational bottlenecks. 3. Customer Communication & Servicing Act as the primary point of contact for customers after order confirmation. Share regular updates on order progress and expected delivery timelines. Coordinate with customers to obtain mockup, artwork, and sample approvals. Ensure customer approvals are documented before proceeding with production. Address customer queries and concerns promptly and professionally. Communicate any changes, delays, or challenges transparently. Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication and reliable execution. Maintain a customer-first approach throughout the order lifecycle. 4. Order Tracking & Timeline Management Maintain and update the centralised order tracking sheet or CRM. Monitor every order against committed timelines. Track critical milestones, including mockup approval, procurement, production, quality checks, packing, dispatch, and delivery. Ensure no order is left unattended or without a clear next action. Identify potential delays in advance and take corrective action. Escalate issues to the relevant team or reporting manager when required. Ensure timely closure of pending activities. 5. Dispatch & Delivery Management Coordinate with logistics and warehouse teams to ensure timely dispatch. Verify shipping addresses, quantities, labels, invoices, and other dispatch documentation. Track shipments until successful delivery. Follow up with courier partners in case of delays or delivery issues. Obtain proof of delivery wherever applicable. Keep customers informed about dispatch and delivery status. Ensure all delivery commitments are met and documented. 6. Complaint & Issue Resolution Take ownership of customer complaints related to damaged products, missing items, incorrect branding, or delivery delays. Coordinate with relevant departments to investigate and resolve issues. Ensure complaints are acknowledged and addressed within defined SLAs. Maintain clear communication with customers until closure. Document complaints and resolutions for future reference. Identify recurring issues and share improvement suggestions with the team. 7. Customer Satisfaction & Relationship Building Collect customer feedback after successful delivery. Encourage customers to share ratings, reviews, and testimonials. Ensure a positive experience at every stage of order execution. Identify opportunities for repeat business and refer them to the sales team. Share customer feedback and improvement opportunities with management. Contribute towards improving customer retention and long-term relationships. 8. Reporting & Process Compliance Prepare daily and weekly updates on active orders, pending approvals, delayed orders, and upcoming deliveries. Maintain accurate records of job cards, customer approvals, communications, and delivery documents. Follow established SOPs and operational workflows. Highlight recurring execution challenges and suggest process improvements. Collaborate with sales and operations teams to improve the order handover process. Ensure timely and accurate updates in the designated CRM or order management system. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Operations, or a related field. 2–3 years of experience in post-sales operations, order management, customer servicing, fulfilment, or operations coordination. Experience in corporate gifting, customised products, printing, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfilment will be an added advantage. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong coordination, follow-up, and stakeholder management abilities. Good planning and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple orders and priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving and issue-resolution capabilities. Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM systems. High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Customer-centric mindset with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 KPI Measurement On-time delivery Percentage of orders delivered within committed timelines Order execution TAT Time taken to complete orders against agreed timelines Mockup approval TAT Time taken to obtain customer approvals Customer satisfaction Customer ratings and feedback Complaint resolution TAT Time taken to resolve customer complaints Order accuracy Percentage of orders delivered without errors Communication efficiency Timely customer updates and follow-ups Documentation accuracy Completeness of job cards, approvals, and delivery records Escalation management Timely identification and resolution of operational issues Customer retention support Repeat-order opportunities identified and referred to sales What We Expect From You Take ownership of every assigned order from job card creation to final delivery. Be proactive rather than waiting for customers or departments to follow up. Anticipate potential challenges and work towards resolving them before they become escalations. Maintain complete visibility of all active orders. Ensure clear communication between customers and internal teams. Be accountable for commitments made to customers. Maintain a high standard of accuracy, professionalism, and customer service. Work collaboratively with the sales team while ensuring a smooth transition from sales to execution. Contribute towards building a scalable and process-driven post-sales function at BoxUp. The BoxUp Way We believe customer experience is not limited to closing a sale. It is defined by how well we deliver on our promises. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, pays attention to details, brings solutions instead of problems, and genuinely cares about creating a great experience for every customer.

 Industry: Fresh Produce / FMCG
 Experience: 3-5 years

 Location: [Mumbai -matunga central]
 Job Overview 
ICHIGO is seeking a hands-on, results-driven Operations Manager to oversee daily operations for its strawberry business. The role covers sourcing coordination, packaging, inventory, cold-chain logistics and order fulfilment, ensuring customers receive fresh, high-quality products on time.
The ideal candidate will have experience managing perishable products, coordinating vendors and teams, controlling costs and reducing wastage.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Daily Operations: Plan and manage product receipt, sorting, grading, packing and dispatch in line with demand and quality standards. Sourcing & Vendor Management: Coordinate with growers, suppliers, packaging vendors and logistics partners to ensure reliable supply and timely deliveries. Quality & Cold Chain: Monitor product freshness, handling, storage temperatures and transport conditions. Coordinate quality checks and resolve product issues. Inventory & Wastage Control: Maintain accurate stock records, batch traceability and expiry tracking. Follow first-expiry-first-out practices and investigate spoilage, damage and stock differences. Packaging & Order Fulfilment: Ensure packaging availability, correct labelling, packing accuracy and timely dispatch across retail, distributor and online channels. Cost & Budget Management: Track procurement, packaging, warehousing and delivery costs. Manage purchase orders, verify vendor invoices and identify savings without compromising quality. Sales & Marketing Coordination: Align stock availability and dispatch capacity with sales forecasts, promotions and seasonal demand. Team & Process Management: Supervise operational staff, establish clear procedures and train teams on hygiene, handling and safety. Reporting: Maintain operational dashboards covering fulfilment, inventory, wastage, quality issues and costs. Candidate Qualifications 
 Experience: 3-5 years in FMCG operations, with hands-on experience in fresh produce, food or other perishable products. Education: Bachelors degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Food Technology or a related field. Operational Knowledge: Experience in inventory management, vendor coordination, warehousing, cold-chain logistics and food safety practices. Job Function: Supply Chain Planning Job Sub Function: Demand Planning Job Category: Professional All Job Posting Locations: Bangalore, Karnataka, India Manager, Demand Planning Statistical Process Capabilities DESCRIPTION JOB SUMMARY This position supports the Demand Planning Process Capabilities Lead in governing statistical forecasting across JJ MedTech. The Manager has full operational accountability for maximizing Anaplan statistical forecasting performance and ensuring the solution consistently meets approved business, process, data and system requirements. The Manager will also lead monthly statistical performance reviews with Business Unit and Regional teams and coordinate user requirements, enhancements and incidents with the Anaplan system team. DUTIES RESPONSIBILITIES The Demand Planning Manager is responsible to: Operational statistical forecasting governance Run the monthly statistical forecasting operating cycle in alignment with the Anaplan calendar, agreed controls and Demand Planning standards. Validate that statistical forecasts meet approved requirements for data completeness, forecast generation, demand-pattern classification, algorithm selection, parameter settings, outlier treatment, non-negative output and forecast release. Identify exceptions and performance gaps, coordinate root-cause analysis and drive corrective actions with the appropriate business or system owner. Monthly statistical review and stakeholder coordination Organize and facilitate a monthly statistical review with Regional Demand Planning teams, including agenda, pre-read, data preparation, decisions, minutes and action tracking. Review MAPE, Bias, Forecast Value Add, statistical adherence, forecast stability, segmentation performance and key product or market exceptions. Translate review findings into prioritized actions with clear owners and due dates, and escalate material risks or unresolved decisions to the Demand Planning Process Capabilities Lead. Statistical performance and continuous improvement Monitor statistical forecast performance across Business Units, Regions, markets and products, with an exception-based focus on the highest-impact gaps. Support reviews of corrected history, outliers, forecast history windows, algorithm and parameter choices, segmentation and touch-policy alignment. Recommend practical improvements that increase forecast accuracy and stability, reduce non-value-added touches and strengthen confidence in the statistical baseline. Demand segmentation and statistical adherence Support periodic validation of demand segmentation and confirm that statistical models and review cadence align with smooth, intermittent, erratic and lumpy demand patterns. Monitor adherence to Stat-Led, High Touch and No Touch policies, distinguishing justified business events from non-value-added baseline overrides. Partner with Regional teams to confirm that the right products are assigned to the right segments and that actions are completed within the agreed planning cycle. User requirements, incidents and enhancements Own the operational intake and central register for user-reported statistical forecasting requirements, Anaplan incidents, defects and enhancement requests. Clarify the business need, document the problem statement, impact, priority, expected outcome and acceptance criteria, and remove duplicate or incomplete requests. Coordinate triage, prioritization, testing, release readiness and user communication with the Anaplan system team; maintain status visibility through closure and confirm that delivered solutions meet requirements. Deliver targeted training, office hours or knowledge-sharing sessions that improve user capability and adoption of agreed statistical planning ways of working. Reporting, controls and collaboration Maintain clear, accurate and timely performance reporting for operational and leadership reviews, using approved data sources and definitions. Track actions, decisions, risks, incidents and enhancement progress, and provide transparent status updates to stakeholders. Build effective working relationships across Global, Business Unit, Regional and Market Demand Planning teams and the Anaplan system team to support consistent execution. QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, Operations Research or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. APICS/ASCM, IBF or comparable forecasting, planning, project or agile certification is desirable. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting concepts, including time-series models, intermittent demand, outlier treatment, forecast accuracy, Bias, Forecast Value Add, demand segmentation and touch-policy governance. Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate operational issues into clear business and system requirements. Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, statistical forecasting, SOP/IBP, planning analytics, process excellence or planning-system capability roles. Hands-on experience reviewing statistical forecast outputs and performance, diagnosing exceptions and coordinating corrective actions with planners, analysts and technical teams. Experience with advanced planning applications; Anaplan experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to Blue Yonder, APO, OMP or comparable platforms is an advantage. Demonstrated experience managing requirement intake, incident or defect logs, enhancement backlogs, prioritization, user acceptance testing and release follow-up. Proven ability to lead recurring operational review meetings and communicate complex analytical or technical topics clearly to global, regional and cross-functional audiences. Experience working in a global, virtual and matrixed organization; MedTech or another regulated industry is preferred. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES Strong understanding of demand planning processes, monthly planning cycles and the interaction between statistical, base and consensus forecasts. Ability to analyse large datasets, identify patterns and root causes, and convert insights into practical actions and system requirements. Disciplined issue, risk and action management, with strong attention to data quality, control effectiveness and follow-through. Excellent written and verbal communication, meeting facilitation and presentation skills. Collaborative and service-oriented mindset, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence without direct authority. Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and time zones and deliver high-quality work within monthly cycle deadlines.
