title: Logistics & Customs Manager
description:
Logistics Customs Manager - Full-time - Mumbai - Onsite About the Company Pharmanovia is a dynamic, fast-growing international pharmaceutical company with a portfolio of over 20 brands across more than 160 markets. Our mission is to improve patient health globally by revitalising niche, trusted medicines. Since our founding in 2013, we have grown consistently year on year, supported by a diverse global team of over 300 employees across 29 nationalities. We operate across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and beyond, focusing on our core therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Oncology, Endocrinology and Neurology. We are an agile, innovative speciality pharma organisation partnering with leading pharmaceutical companies to maximise the lifecycle value of established medicines. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Logistics Customs Manager to join our Global Supply Chain team based in India, supporting Pharmanovia s rapidly expanding international operations. This is a truly global position, responsible for managing the end-to-end logistics and customs operations across Pharmanovia s international trade lanes between India and key markets throughout Europe, LATAM, APAC and the Middle East Africa (MEA). You will oversee both exports of finished pharmaceutical products from India and imports of materials and goods into India, ensuring compliant, efficient and cost-effective movement of products throughout our global supply chain. Leading an international logistics team with colleagues based in both India and Europe, you will work closely with Regional Supply Chain teams, Quality, Finance, Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs), freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse providers and external logistics partners across multiple regions. This role is ideal for an experienced international logistics professional with a strong background in pharmaceutical supply chains, customs compliance and global trade, who enjoys working in a fast-paced, collaborative and highly regulated environment. Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end international logistics strategy for all shipments between India and Pharmanovia s markets across Europe, LATAM, APAC and MEA, ensuring safe, compliant and timely product movement. Own all customs and international trade compliance activities, ensuring imports and exports comply with Indian customs legislation as well as international customs regulations across multiple global markets. Manage international freight operations, including air, sea and road transportation, ensuring optimum service levels, cost efficiency and on-time delivery performance. Lead and develop an international logistics team, including direct reports based in Europe, providing leadership, coaching, performance management and continuous development. Develop strategic relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PL providers and warehouse partners, ensuring high performance, contractual compliance and continuous service improvement. Ensure uninterrupted pharmaceutical supply by proactively managing logistics risks, customs delays and transportation challenges across global trade lanes. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across logistics operations, identifying opportunities to optimise transportation costs, improve lead times and enhance customer service. Monitor and manage logistics KPIs, preparing regular performance reports and using operational data to improve supply chain performance. Ensure full compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and Pharmanovia Quality Management System requirements throughout the international distribution network. Lead customs clearance activities, working closely with customs brokers and authorities to minimise delays and ensure compliant import and export operations. Manage bonded warehouse and Free Trade Zone operations, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency where applicable. Ensure compliance with global anti-counterfeiting legislation, including the EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD), product serialisation and product traceability requirements. Own logistics SOPs, policies and operational procedures, ensuring documentation remains current, compliant and aligned with global standards. Lead investigations into logistics deviations, customs issues and distribution incidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing effective CAPAs. Monitor changes in international trade legislation, customs regulations and pharmaceutical distribution requirements, proactively implementing business process improvements. Partner closely with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing and Commercial teams to ensure seamless supply chain execution across all regions. Support Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) by coordinating international shipment planning, customs requirements and inventory movements. Manage logistics budgets, transportation spend and supplier performance to maximise operational efficiency while maintaining service excellence. Lead regular business reviews with logistics providers, monitoring contractual performance against agreed service levels and KPIs. Provide expert advice to internal stakeholders on customs regulations, import/export requirements and international trade compliance. Support business continuity planning, ensuring robust contingency plans are in place to minimise disruption across global supply chains. Represent Pharmanovia during audits, inspections and regulatory assessments relating to logistics, GDP and customs compliance. Travel internationally as required to support regional teams, logistics partners and business operations. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Trade, Business or a related discipline. Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Office skills. Experience using ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC or equivalent Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Required Skills Minimum 8 years experience within international logistics, supply chain or global trade. Strong experience managing international import and export operations. Experience working within pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences or other highly regulated industries. Experience managing complex global trade lanes across multiple international markets. Proven experience leading international logistics teams, including remote management of overseas employees. Strong experience managing freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehouse providers and third-party logistics partners. Experience negotiating logistics contracts and supplier service agreements. Experience managing customs compliance within India and international markets. Experience implementing logistics process improvements and operational efficiencies. Experience managing international transportation budgets and logistics KPIs. Experience supporting Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) and global manufacturing operations. Preferred Skills Professional qualification in Customs Compliance, International Trade, Supply Chain or Logistics. APICS, CILT, CSCMP or equivalent professional certification. Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement certification. title: NU-Project Execution Lead Planner
description:
Job Description Summary The Lead Engineering Planner will be responsible for developing, integrating, and maintaining high-quality engineering project schedules across HDNU Gas Power Engineering. This role supports proposal, contract, and execution phases, ensuring schedule rigor, transparency, and alignment with business objectives. The position plays a key role in improving planning maturity, schedule quality, and delivery performance across projects and portfolios. Job Description Engineering & Project Scheduling Develop, release, and maintain complex, integrated engineering project schedules using Primavera P6, ensuring alignment with scope, execution strategy, and contractual requirements. Execute project schedules for assigned Gas Power Business scopes (including Gas Turbine/Generator/Steam Turbine/HRSG and Balance of Plant engineering), ensuring schedule integrity throughout the project lifecycle. Convert proposal and tender schedules into fully integrated contract schedules, adjusting activity logic, durations, and sequencing based on finalized engineering scope. Prepare and manage Tender Time Schedules (TTS), Overall Time Schedules (OTS), Master Time Schedules (MTS), System Time Schedules (STS), and portfolio-level schedules as required. Establish and maintain baseline schedules, manage revisions (Rebaseline), and control schedule changes through formal change logs. Proposal & Contract Support Partner with ITO and Proposal teams to define engineering support requirements, develop schedule assumptions, scope matrices, and delivery sequences. Participate in deviation and clarification meetings, supporting schedule alignment during proposal and contract finalization. Provide schedule inputs for contract negotiations and support preparation of contract documentation. Schedule Control & Performance Monitoring Monitor, update, and control project schedules based on engineering progress inputs (including PLM interfaces). title: Sr Executive - Supply Chain & Operations
description:
About us Welcome to Swiss Beauty, the fastest-growing beauty and cosmetics brand in India. Established in 2013, Swiss Beauty aims to be the ultimate companion and BFF of every makeup lover, transforming beauty routines into extraordinary experiences. With a focus on Indian beauty needs, we merge global cosmetic standards with our expertise to create highly innovative, long-lasting, and comfortable products. Our mission is to elevate beauty to Swiss standards and offer game-changing products that set new benchmarks in the industry. We believe that makeup knows no boundaries and is for everyone. Join us on this remarkable journey as we redefine beauty norms and celebrate individuality. Role Purpose To manage day-to-day supply chain operations, ensuring smooth order processing, inventory movement, warehouse coordination, logistics execution, returns management, reconciliation, and timely closure of operational issues. Key Responsibilities 1. Order & Order Management Manage end-to-end order processing from order receipt to dispatch and delivery. Coordinate with E-commerce, Sales, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance teams for smooth order execution. Monitor pending orders, cancellations, short supply, and delivery-related issues. Ensure accurate order processing and timely resolution of exceptions. 2. Inventory & Stock Management Monitor stock availability, inventory movement and ageing across locations/channels. Coordinate with warehouse teams for stock allocation, picking, packing and dispatch. Maintain inventory accuracy and investigate stock variances. Support stock forecasting and replenishment planning based on business requirements. 3. Warehouse & Logistics Operations Coordinate with warehouse and 3PL partners for timely dispatch, delivery, and stock movement. Monitor inward, outward, GRN, POD and shipment-related activities. Track delivery performance and resolve operational exceptions with logistics partners. Ensure required documentation is maintained for all movements. 4. Returns & Reverse Logistics Manage customer/partner returns, RTO and RTV activities. Coordinate with warehouse teams for return receiving, QC, segregation and system booking. Track pending returns, discrepancies, shortages, damages, and excess quantities. Coordinate with partners for required documents, PODs, invoices, return references, and closure. 5. Reconciliation & Commercial Closure Perform regular reconciliation of sales, dispatch, delivery, returns, and inventory data. Identify mismatches between ERP/system data and partner records. Follow up with internal and external stakeholders for resolution of open cases. Support Credit Note, Debit Note, claims and recovery-related activities. 6. MIS & Reporting Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS and operational dashboards. Track KPIs such as order fulfilment, fill rate, inventory accuracy, returns, RTO, pending GRN, delivery performance and reconciliation status. Analyse operational data and highlight key gaps, risks, and action points to management. Maintain accurate trackers and ensure timely data updates. 7. Process Improvement Identify recurring operational issues and work on corrective actions. Improve SOP adherence, documentation, and tracker management. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and reduce operational delays. Support automation and ERP/system improvements wherever required. Key Stakeholder Management Warehouse & 3PL Partners Logistics & Courier Partners E-commerce / Marketplace Teams Sales & Commercial Teams Finance & Accounts Procurement IT / ERP Team External Business Partners / Vendors Required Skills Strong knowledge of Supply Chain and Operations processes. Good understanding of Order Management, Inventory, Warehouse and Logistics operations. Experience in Returns / Reverse Logistics and reconciliation. Strong Excel/MIS skills including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and data analysis. Working knowledge of ERP/SAP or other order/inventory management systems. Strong follow-up and stakeholder coordination skills. Good analytical and problem-solving ability. Ability to manage multiple activities and meet timelines. Good communication and documentation skills. Preferred Experience Experience in E-commerce / FMCG / Consumer Goods / Retail / D2C operations. Exposure to marketplace operations and 3PL management will be an advantage. Experience in ERP-based order processing, inventory and reconciliation will be preferred. Key Performance Indicators Order fulfilment and on-time dispatch Inventory accuracy Order processing accuracy Return/RTO closure TAT GRN and POD closure Reconciliation closure Claims / CN / DN recovery Reduction in operational discrepancies Timely and accurate MIS reporting Process adherence and improvement

title: Customer Care Executive- International process
description:
Role & responsibilities Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Customer Support • Handle inbound customer calls professionally and courteously. • Make outbound calls for booking confirmations, follow-ups, and issue resolution. • Respond to customer emails, chat requests, and social media tickets within SLA. • Deliver exceptional service with a positive and professional attitude. • Build customer satisfaction and provide prompt, accurate assistance. 2. Reservation Management • Assist customers in making new vehicle reservations. • Modify existing reservations as per customer requirements. • Process booking cancellations as per company policies. • Explain rental procedures, booking policies, pricing, and vehicle availability. • Verify customer information before confirming reservations. • Provide rental confirmations and booking details accurately. 3. Vehicle Rental Assistance • Guide customers regarding available vehicle categories. • Explain rental packages and pricing structures. • Assist customers in selecting suitable vehicles based on travel needs. • Inform customers about insurance coverage and optional add-on services. • Explain fuel policies, mileage limits, security deposits, and rental agreements. 4. Customer Query Resolution • Handle inquiries related to: Reservations, Booking Modifications, Cancellations, Rental Extensions, Vehicle Upgrades, Rental Charges, Security Deposits, Billing Clarification, Payment Status, Refund Processing, Loyalty Programs, Promotional Offers, Pickup/Drop-off Locations, Vehicle Availability. 5. Roadside Assistance Coordination • Coordinate support for emergency situations: vehicle breakdowns, flat tire, battery jump start, lockout assistance, accident reporting, vehicle replacement requests, towing coordination, and emergency roadside support. • Ensure timely communication and continuous updates until the issue is resolved. 6. Complaint Handling • Resolve customer complaints professionally. • Understand customer concerns patiently. • De-escalate difficult situations. • Coordinate with internal departments for resolution. • Ensure customer satisfaction before closing complaints. • Maintain ownership until final resolution. 7. Documentation • Accurately document every customer interaction including call notes, booking updates, complaint details, resolution steps, escalation history, and customer feedback. • Maintain complete records in the CRM system

title: Customer Support Manager - Gold Loan
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Customer Support Manager to lead customer service and contact centre operations for our Gold Loan business. The role will manage customer support teams, ensure service quality, handle escalations, support sales and collections, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Contact Centre & Customer Support: Manage inbound/outbound operations; plan staffing, shifts and workforce utilization; monitor AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS, service levels, call volumes and TAT; resolve customer queries and escalations; support lead follow-ups, sales, collections, renewals and retention. Team Management: Recruit, train, coach and manage Customer Support Executives and Team Leaders; set KPIs; conduct performance reviews and build a customer-focused team. Quality & Process: Conduct call-quality audits; ensure SOP and company-policy adherence; support RBI/NBFC compliance; identify process gaps and improve TAT and repeat-contact rates. MIS & Analytics: Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS; analyze productivity, call volumes, service levels and customer metrics; provide actionable insights to management. Technology & Vendor Management: Coordinate CRM, telephony, IVR, ticketing and customer-service platforms with IT; manage outsourced contact-centre/vendor coordination where applicable. Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Sales, Operations, Collections, Product, Marketing, IT, Compliance and Branch teams; support new projects, product launches and campaigns. 
 Required Skills 
 Strong customer service and escalation management skills. Excellent leadership, people-management and decision-making abilities. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Process improvement and SOP implementation experience. Strong analytical and MIS reporting capabilities. Good MS Excel skills; Power BI/Tableau is an advantage. Experience with CRM, ticketing, telephony, IVR and omnichannel platforms. Understanding of RBI/NBFC customer-service and data-privacy requirements. Strong stakeholder and project-management skills. 
 Preferred Industry Experience 
 Gold Loan / NBFC industry experience is mandatory/preferred. Candidates with relevant experience in Gold Loan, NBFC, Banking, Financial Services, Contact Centre/BPO, Customer Support, Telesales, Collections or Customer Relationship Management will be considered. 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in the Gold Loan / NBFC industry . Graduate in any discipline with proven contact-centre/customer-support team management experience. • Female candidates only. Strong experience in team handling, escalations, customer service and operational KPIs. Comfortable working from the New Town, Yelahanka, Bangalore office. 
 Languages 
 Must be proficient in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Hindi. 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 
 Key Competencies Leadership | Customer Experience | Contact Centre Management | Team Handling | Escalation Management | MIS & Analytics | Process Improvement | Sales Support | Collections Support | Stakeholder Management | Compliance

title: General Manager For Research and Development
description:
Job Description Job Title General Manager / Deputy General Manager Research & Development (Specialty Chemicals Development) Department Research & Development (R&D) Reports To Cheif Technology Officer R&D / Business Head Job Summary The General Manager – R&D will lead the organization's Research & Development function for the development of innovative specialty chemicals and advanced polymer solutions. The role is responsible for driving new product development, application development, process optimization, technology transfer, and intellectual property creation across multiple business segments, particularly water and wastewater treatment chemicals, specialty polymers, ion exchange resins, membranes, and allied technologies. The incumbent will provide strategic and technical leadership to multidisciplinary R&D teams while collaborating closely with Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and external stakeholders to accelerate innovation, commercialize new technologies, and support the organization's long-term growth strategy. Educational Qualifications Ph.D. in Polymer Science, Polymer Technology, Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed university. Minimum 15 years of industrial R&D experience after completion of Ph.D. OR M.Tech./M.Sc. in Polymer Science/Technology, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related discipline with 20–22 years of industrial R&D experience . Experience Requirements The ideal candidate should possess extensive industrial experience in: Development of specialty chemicals for water and wastewater treatment. Polymer chemistry, polymer synthesis, formulation development, and advanced characterization. Product scale-up and commercialization. Managing multidisciplinary R&D teams and innovation programs. Technology transfer from laboratory to manufacturing. Technical Expertise A. Specialty Chemicals for Water & Wastewater Treatment Hands-on experience in product and application development of: Antiscalants, Corrosion inhibitors, Industrial cleaning chemicals Biocides, Green chemicals, Defoamers, Flocculants, Dispersants Responsibilities include: Development of new formulations. Enhancement of existing products for improved performance, quality, processability, and cost optimization. Application development for industrial water and wastewater treatment systems. B. Specialty Polymers Strong expertise in the development of: Polyelectrolytes, Emulsion polymers, Polymer dispersants, Polymer flocculants Green polymer inhibitors Application knowledge in industries such as: Water treatment Paper, Textile, Ceramic, Petrochemical & refinery, Process industries Additional expertise in the following will be considered a strong advantage: Ion exchange resins, Polymeric adsorbents, Catalyst resins Porous polymers, Separation and purification technologies Chromatographic materials, Advanced catalytic systems Key Responsibilities: Research & Innovation Leadership Lead the R&D strategy for specialty chemicals, polymers, ion exchange resins, membranes, and related technologies. Drive new product ideation, design, development, validation, and commercialization. Lead technically complex innovation projects from concept through commercialization. Develop capability roadmaps aligned with business growth objectives. Identify emerging technologies and convert scientific opportunities into commercial products. Product & Application Development Develop innovative formulations for water and wastewater treatment applications. Improve existing products for enhanced efficiency, sustainability, quality, and cost competitiveness. Conduct feasibility studies and establish product development protocols. Support application development across multiple industrial segments. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Quality Assurance, and Business Teams. Engage with customers to understand application challenges and translate market needs into product innovations. Coordinate technology transfer activities with manufacturing plants. Work with suppliers and external technical partners for new raw materials and technologies. Project & Laboratory Management Lead and manage multiple R&D projects simultaneously. Oversee laboratory operations, infrastructure, and technical capabilities. Ensure timely execution of development programs within budget and timelines. Support pilot plant trials, process optimization, and commercial scale-up activities. Intellectual Property & Scientific Documentation Drive patent identification, drafting, filing, and protection activities. Coordinate with patent attorneys and consultants. Prepare and review: Know-How Dockets (KHDs) Product Bulletins Product Data Sheets Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS/SDS) Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) Technical Reports Scientific Publications Process Excellence & Sustainability Lead initiatives for: Process optimization Raw material cost (RMC) reduction ETP load reduction Waste minimization Energy efficiency Sustainable chemistry implementation Drive green chemistry initiatives aligned with organizational sustainability goals. Quality, Compliance & Safety Ensure implementation and compliance with: ISO Management Systems Laboratory Safety Standards Process Safety & HAZOP studies DSIR requirements Regulatory and statutory compliance Maintain documentation supporting product lifecycle management. Ensure proper handover of specifications, Bill of Materials (BOM), analytical methods, and manufacturing documentation.  This role will be responsible for developing and executing internal communication strategies supporting business entities, HR functions, and sub-divisional priorities.

Develop and execute communication campaigns across platforms such as Poppulo, Knak, Viva Engage, SharePoint , and other enterprise communication channels. Drive content governance, campaign execution, audience targeting, and channel effectiveness. Support intranet content management, employee engagement campaigns, newsletters, and organizational updates. Leverage analytics and engagement metrics to continuously enhance communication performance. Creative Content Development & Multimedia Communications Develop engaging content including articles, newsletters, leadership communications, presentations, videos, infographics, and employee-facing campaigns. Create visually compelling communication assets using graphic design and multimedia tools. Partner with stakeholders to translate business priorities into simple, impactful communications. Ensure content is audience-focused, engaging, and aligned with communications objectives. Support executive presentations, town halls, leadership forums, and employee engagement initiatives. Project Management & Communications Operations Lead end-to-end planning, governance, execution, and measurement of communications programs and projects. Manage communication calendars, campaign schedules, stakeholder reviews, and approval processes. Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver communication initiatives on time and within scope. Maintain communication standards, processes, and best practices across multiple workstreams. Support business priorities through effective project management and communications execution. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in English Literature, Journalism, Mass Communication, Communications, Public Relations , or a related discipline. Professional certifications in Communications, Change Management, Marketing Communications, or Project Management are preferred. 5-8 years of experience in Internal Communications, Corporate Communications, Employee Communications, Change Communications, or related functions. Proven experience developing and executing enterprise-wide communication strategies and engagement programs. Hands-on experience using communication platforms such as Poppulo, Knak, Viva Engage, SharePoint , or similar communication technologies. Experience supporting change management initiatives, employee engagement programs, and organizational communications. Demonstrated success in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) industry. Experience supporting large-scale organizations, Global Capability Centers (GCCs), or multinational environments. Strong background in employee engagement, culture communications, and organizational transformation initiatives. Experience working with communication agencies, creative vendors, or multimedia production partners. Location This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

title: PMIC Analog Design Manager
description:
Change the world. Love your job. 
 We are looking for an experienced Analog Design Manager to lead a team of talented engineers developing next-generation Power Management ICs for advanced personal electronics applications. This is a techno-managerial role - we are looking for someone who remains deeply engaged in the technical fabric of the work: contributing to architectural decisions, shaping design direction, and staying close to silicon, along with managing people and delivery. You will drive technical execution across the full PMIC development cycle - from architecture definition and circuit design through silicon bring-up and customer qualification - while building and growing a world-class analog design team. Collaborate with internal teams including layout, systems, verification and validation as well as directly with customers, translating complex system-level requirements into innovative silicon solutions. For strong technical contributors, the door to TIs technical career ladder remains open - though the primary growth trajectory in this role is toward senior engineering management and broader technical leadership across programs and teams. Basic Requirements: 
 - Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or related field (Masters or PhD preferred)
 - 10+ years of analog/mixed-signal IC design experience with a strong track record in power management
 - Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and projects in a silicon design environment
 - 2+ years of experience directly managing analog design engineers (performance management, hiring, career development) in a semiconductor/IC design environment
 - Deep expertise in power converter topologies: buck, boost, LDO, charge pump
 - Hands-on experience across the full IC design flow: schematic, simulation, layout review, silicon bring-up, and characterization
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills
 - Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience communicating program status, risks, and technical decisions to senior leadership and cross-functional teams Preferred Skills: 
 - Experience designing PMICs for consumer electronics applications (mobile, laptops, wearables)
 - Fully proficient and comfortable with standard Power IC design flows end-to-end (Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre)
 - Worst-case analysis, top-level and Monte Carlo simulation, and post-layout PEX verification
 - Physical layout review: power routing, grounding, thermal management, and die area optimization
 - Background in high-performance, high-efficiency analog design with aggressive power and area targets
 - Familiarity with advanced CMOS process nodes
 - Experience working directly with customers on technical alignment and specification definition
 - Exposure to tools including Simplis, AMS, or equivalent (good to have)
 - Demonstrated ability to drive customer and cross-functional technical discussions with authority and ownership
 - Proven track record of mentoring engineers through complex design challenges
 - Ability to manage and personally execute multiple concurrent design tasks on aggressive schedules with high autonomy
